instruction: A single tall sunflower: a thick fuzzy green stem, a few broad leaves, and a large disc flower head with a thick textured brown seed center ringed by two layers of pointed yellow petals. Turned slightly toward the light.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a sunflower. A single tall sunflower: a thick fuzzy green stem, a few broad leaves, and a large disc flower head with a thick textured brown seed center ringed by two layers of pointed yellow petals. Turned slightly toward the light. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
